acceptance_criteria: Provider rejection, provider timeout, malformed output, schema-invalid output, valid empty decisions, all-discarded decisions, partial writes, and confirmed promotions have distinct typed outcomes.
Production search failure cannot become a successfully observed empty result, and every model-output field is bounded and membership-validated.
Dry-run reports would-promote intent while committed promotion and confirmed-write counters remain zero.
runOnce returns its typed report and never logs complete for failed, partial, cancelled, stalled, or unreadable work.
Provider and write operations have propagated deadlines, and an expired or stopped run cannot perform a later remote mutation.
Repeated skipped ticks and oldest-active age degrade restart-aware health through stable content-free causes.
Durable receipts distinguish disabled, not-started, no-work, dry-run, current, partial, failed, stalled, cancelling, abandoned, and unreadable states across restart.
Receipts, logs, health, alerts, and metrics exclude memory text, claims, source IDs, model output, content hashes, raw exceptions, credentials, and private deployment data.
Detailed run evidence has bounded retention whose observation and cleanup failures affect health.
blast_radius: Memory search, clustering, model validation, promotion and discard writes, dry-run reporting, scheduler overlap and shutdown, restart recovery, runtime and top-level health, alerts, durable evidence retention, operator diagnosis, and provider failure taxonomy.
evidence_summary: Three fresh stable reads pinned the open identity, empty labels, update time, URL, and exact 12,547-byte body hash while API and SSH main remained 160a2c2fb2bfeda3189d70ba5bb9c5dd5f9799cd. The main advance from the prior audit pin changed only agent runtime presentation files outside this target; all 21 jointly audited target paths remained byte-identical to the new pin. Exact-main consolidateCluster converts provider rejection and parse failure into the ordinary empty result and validates only the two top-level arrays. runConsolidation calls the lossy search API, increments processed before outcome is known, uses promoted for dry-run intent, and cannot distinguish the swallowed failure from a valid no-promotion decision. runOnce returns void and logs resolved reports as complete; a hung run makes later ticks skip, while stop can time out with the active promise retained and no cancellation or post-stop mutation fence. No durable run receipt or consolidation health reader exists. The fresh pinned-runtime target suite passed 253 of 253 tests across six files, including accepted failure-to-empty, skipped-overlap, and stop-timeout behavior. falsifier_or_remaining_gap: The finding would be falsified by typed per-cluster and run outcomes, strict bounded output validation, status-preserving search, propagated deadlines and cancellation, post-stop write fencing, durable bounded receipts, and restart-aware health that distinguishes success from no-work, dry-run, partial, failed, stalled, and unreadable states. Exact-main source has none. Provider and write race fault injection, retention migration, and recovery policy remain implementation obligations.
impact: Provider outages and malformed output can look identical to valid no-promotion decisions, dry-run intent can look committed, a hung operation can suppress all later cycles without health evidence, shutdown can return while an expired operation may still mutate remote memory, and restart erases the only attempt and failure state.
